question: What changed in the employee handbook?
description: Compare each edition with the 2022 baseline. Open the clauses for the wording behind each change.

sources.label: Method
sources.value: Compare matching clauses against the 2022 baseline.

findings.label: Remote work · 2023
findings.value: Employees may work remotely three days per week with manager approval.

findings.label: Parental leave · 2024
findings.value: Primary caregivers are entitled to sixteen weeks of paid leave.

findings.label: Remote work · 2022
findings.value: Employees may work remotely two days per week with manager approval.

findings.label: Remote work · 2025
findings.value: Employees may work remotely three days per week by team agreement.

findings.label: Parental leave · 2025
findings.value: Primary caregivers are entitled to eighteen weeks of paid leave.
